build_cmd: mkdir -p .build/membrowse_ld && qmk compile -kb crkbd/rev1 -km default -e DEBUG_ENABLE=yes > .build/membrowse_build.log 2>&1 || { cat .build/membrowse_build.log; exit 1; }; ELF=.build/crkbd_rev1_default.elf && { avr-nm "$ELF" | awk '$2=="A" && $3 ~ /_REGION_/ {print $3 " = 0x" $1 ";"}'; avr-ld -m "$(avr-readelf -h "$ELF" | sed -n 's/.*avr:\([0-9]*\).*/avr\1/p')" --verbose | sed -n '/^======/,/^======/p' | grep -v '^======'; } > .build/membrowse_ld/linker.ld

mkdir -p .build/membrowse_ld && qmk compile -kb ergodox_ez/base -km default -e DEBUG_ENABLE=yes > .build/membrowse_build.log 2>&1 || { cat .build/membrowse_build.log; exit 1; }; ELF=.build/ergodox_ez_base_default.elf && { avr-nm "$ELF" | awk '$2=="A" && $3 ~ /_REGION_/ {print $3 " = 0x" $1 ";"}'; avr-ld -m "$(avr-readelf -h "$ELF" | sed -n 's/.*avr:\([0-9]*\).*/avr\1/p')" --verbose | sed -n '/^======/,/^======/p' | grep -v '^======'; } > .build/membrowse_ld/linker.ld

mkdir -p .build/membrowse_ld && qmk compile -kb planck/rev6 -km default -e DEBUG_ENABLE=yes -e VERBOSE_LD_CMD=yes > .build/membrowse_build.log 2>&1 || { cat .build/membrowse_build.log; exit 1; }; LDCMD=$(grep -m1 -- ' -T' .build/membrowse_build.log) && for d in $(echo "$LDCMD" | grep -o -- '-L[^ ]*' | sed 's/^-L//' | grep -v '^/'); do cp "$d"/*.ld .build/membrowse_ld/; done && cp "$(echo "$LDCMD" | sed 's/.*-T *\([^ ]*\.ld\).*/\1/')" .build/membrowse_ld/linker.ld

mkdir -p .build/membrowse_ld && qmk compile -kb crkbd/rev4_1/standard -km default -e DEBUG_ENABLE=yes -e VERBOSE_LD_CMD=yes > .build/membrowse_build.log 2>&1 || { cat .build/membrowse_build.log; exit 1; }; LDCMD=$(grep -m1 -- ' -T' .build/membrowse_build.log) && for d in $(echo "$LDCMD" | grep -o -- '-L[^ ]*' | sed 's/^-L//' | grep -v '^/'); do cp "$d"/*.ld .build/membrowse_ld/; done && cp "$(echo "$LDCMD" | sed 's/.*-T *\([^ ]*\.ld\).*/\1/')" .build/membrowse_ld/linker.ld
